messages.subject: DSM Engine and possibly special character probs
parts:
Hello dear List! While attempting to reproduce the dolphins DSM sample pr=
oject, I've encountered the following error message:

win.metafile(filename=3D'visgam6.%02d.wmf',width=3D7,height=3D5,pointsize=
=3D12)
Unable to create metafile

I have installed the correct version of R, made the whole R directory rea=
dable, installed the library package supplied by distance as root, everyt=
hing seems to work ok. However, upon running the analysis, the above ment=
ioned error message appears. Running the analysis in debug mode and then =
copying the very same script created into a running R console works fine.=
Therefore I suspect this to be a problem with the %02 in the filename, s=
ince I am using Windows 7 (and since Microsoft doesn't really care about =
internationalization, problems are usually caused by the OS). Am I correc=
t and what should I do to change that?

Thanks in advance!

PS: Of course i DON'T want to run the analysis completely within R, since=
Distance should do this for me.
